name: Japan (Imperial Standard)

colors.symbolism: the golden chrysanthemum of the imperial house

description: A red field charged at the centre with the golden sixteen-petal chrysanthemum crest of the Imperial House.
history: The standard of the Emperor of Japan: the chrysanthemum seal on red has marked the Emperor since the Meiji era (the modern form dates from 1926).

features.symbolism: the mon of the Imperial House of Japan
